description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Send feedback or a bug report to the app's developer on the cook's behalf. Goes into the same triage queue as the in-app form, tagged as agent-submitted.

contact.description: Optional email so the developer can reply. Only include it if the cook offers one — never invent one.

kind.description: 'feedback' for an opinion or request; 'bug' for something broken.

message.description: What the cook wants to say, in their own words where possible.

rating.description: Feedback only. How they feel about the app overall.

severity.description: Bug only. 'blocking' means they cannot cook with it.

steps.description: Bug only. How to reproduce it.

name: send_report

attachedContext.description: Context the server attached; nothing here was invented by the model.

status.description: Always 'new' — it has not been triaged yet.

telemetryAttached.description: false — full device telemetry only comes from the in-app form.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Send feedback or a bug report
